# Systems

This folder catalogs the technical systems that support healthcare operations and data validation within the Danish acute surgery context. It currently focuses on the digital information infrastructure, specifically the platforms used by hospitals and regions to manage clinical records, track population indicators, and verify database accuracy. By documenting these systems, the wiki provides context for how clinical data is captured, aggregated, and audited across the healthcare network.

## Pages

- [[entities/systems/healthcare-information-systems/index|Healthcare Information Systems]] — The digital infrastructure, including electronic patient journals and regional management systems, used to validate clinical records and conduct sample controls.
